description: Starts a Chrome or Chromium binary on the Uptime Kuma host and returns its version, to check that real-browser monitors without a remote browser can run. Defaults to the chromeExecutable setting those monitors use. With no path set, Uptime Kuma looks for one, and in its Docker image INSTALLS Chromium with apt when none is there, which can take minutes. Only paths on Uptime Kuma's own list of known Chrome locations are allowed, unless its host sets UPTIME_KUMA_ALLOW_ALL_CHROME_EXEC=1. For a remote browser use testRemoteBrowser.

executable.description: Path of the binary to start, e.g. "/usr/bin/chromium". "" auto-detects; "#playwright_chromium" is the Chromium Playwright downloaded. Default: the chromeExecutable setting.

name: testChrome
title: Test Chrome
